about.greeting: Hello, I'm Augusto Almeida — a technology enthusiast who transforms lines of code into solutions that truly make a difference. My mission? Building systems that unite innovation, performance, and real impact.
about.professionalDescription: I work as a Developer and Test Engineer, with experiences ranging from startups to large corporations. I've built responsive interfaces that delight users, developed robust APIs that connect entire ecosystems, and automated tests that ensure end-to-end quality. My journey combines analytical vision, attention to detail, and creativity to solve complex problems.
about.expertiseDescription: I specialize in fullstack development (Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Angular, Next.js), API integration (REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, gRPC), and modern architectures (Clean, Hexagonal, and Microservices). Additionally, I master DevOps and QA practices, using Docker, CI/CD, and test automation with Pytest, Jest, and Cypress to deliver reliable and scalable software.
